items.text: Delayed dispatches from Canton Indicated today that the bandit menace In Northern Kwangtung Province has lessened, although border cities continued to appeal to provincial authorities for more troops in the endangered area. A dispatch from Bhiuchow said Consul Jenkins had not ordered Americans there to evacuate the city because of banditry. A message last Thursday said Jenkins had warned Americans to move out.
